policies.name: records-are-readable-but-ssn-is-redacted
policies.code:
@obligate_redact("ssn")
permit(principal, action == Action::"read", resource) when { context.record_type == "customer" };

policies.name: internal-notes-are-readable-in-full
policies.code: permit(principal, action == Action::"read", resource) when { context.record_type == "note" };

policies.name: exports-are-capped-and-never-logged

tests.name: a customer record may be read - with the SSN redacted
an internal note may be read in full - no obligations
an export is allowed under three obligations at once
an unknown record type is denied - a Deny carries no obligations
